text:
mike: Heads-up — planning a staged release tonight 23:00–01:00 PST. Deploy set = runtime v2.3.0, api v1.9.0 (header swap), router v5.7. Need cross-service pin & a clear fallback latch. Canaries: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~40m. Any blockers?

sara: Console needs a minor schema opt for the header. Is that gated by API version or opt-in?

ben: Router folks: v5.7 includes the new header-route match. I ran local simulation; fallback to header-less should work but need pin to previous route config during canary.

carla: Runtime note: v2.3.0 changes KV eviction heuristics. If we hit high tail latency we should pin back to runtime:v2.2.9. Also recommend setting cache ttl short during canary.

mike: Good call. Proposed rollback pins: runtime:v2.2.9, api:v1.8.4, router:v5.6.8. Console stays on current schema until we flip header flag.

deploybot: Preflight checks started by @mike at 2025-11-18T22:12:00Z
```
Preflight summary:
- infra health: OK
- existing canary tokens available: 6
- router compatibility: WARN (route-match test 1/3 flaky)
- runtime binary checksum: OK
- api migration plan: OK
```

ben: That router WARN worries me. Which route-match test failed?

deploybot: route-match test #2 failed on 3/100 simulated sessions (timeout). Details available in logs: https://internal/logs/route-test-1757779123

carla: Timeout could be due to KV latency under new eviction. We'll pre-warm through a small ramp and watch p95.

ops-oncall: Suggest adding an automated latch: if p95 latency increases > 200ms over baseline for 3 consecutive minutes OR 5xx > 1% for 5m, abort and pin rollback. Also keep canary window at 25% for at least 20m before full. :eyes:

mike: Agree. I'll add the latch rules to the deploy plan and attach rollback commands.

mike: Rollback command (if needed):
```
# pin back versions
cli deploy pin --service runtime --version v2.2.9 --reason "rollback from v2.3.0"
cli deploy pin --service api --version v1.8.4 --reason "rollback from v1.9.0"
cli deploy pin --service router --version v5.6.8 --reason "rollback from v5.7"
```

sara: For console, we'll hold the header flag off until given explicit GO. I'll watch dashboards.

ben: I'll re-run the route-match test with a 30s retry window and post results in 10m. If green, proceed with 5% canary at 23:00.

deploybot: Note: deploy window is marked quiet-window. All paging suppressed except ops-oncall.

mike: Final plan: 23:00 start -> 5% canary (10m) -> 25% hold (20m) with latch criteria (ops-oncall thresholds) -> 100% if green. Pins/rollback ready. @ben pls confirm route-test before 22:59. If route-test still flaky -> abort.

ops-oncall: I'll be watching TTL, p95, error-rate. Paging if latch trips. GLHF. :thumbsup:

ben: Route test re-run: PASS (0/200 failures) after retry window. Proceeding with scheduled canary.

mike: Thanks — kicking off the release per the plan. Keep chatter here for quick rollback notes.
